gold_code_mapping._description: Maps each Gold KBLI code to its Kepmenaker category and available jabatan

most_restrictive_sectors.insight: Only Country Manager, IT Consultant, and Operations Advisor. Foreign bike/car rental operators must be directors/komisaris under KEDUA provision.
Only 6 positions for 14 Gold codes. Most foreign real estate operators work as Directors under KEDUA provision.
Only 12 positions for Bali's entire hospitality sector. No F&B Manager, no Bar Manager, no Sommelier. Chef (Juru Masak Ahli) is critical — only culinary position available.
Legal Advisor, Legal Consultant, Accountant. No separate positions for IP consultants or auditors.

most_permissive_sectors.insight: 239 positions — virtually every IT role is open to TKA. Most TKA-friendly sector by far.
181 positions from managers to tradespeople. Covers all construction specializations.
143 positions. Native speaker language teachers (8 languages) are specifically listed. 46 university lecturer fields. 81+ trainer/instructor specializations.
57 positions including 20+ sports coach specializations (surfing, diving, yoga, fitness, etc.). Key for Bali's wellness/adventure tourism.

kedua_provision.description: Komisaris and Direktur who do NOT manage personalia can work without being in the jabatan list (Bagian KEDUA of Kepmenaker 228/2019)
kedua_provision.practical_impact: This is how most foreign business owners in restrictive sectors (real estate, rental, F&B) legally operate — they serve as Directors of their PT PMA
kedua_provision.critical_distinction: Must NOT handle HR/personalia functions — that must be delegated to Indonesian staff

temporary_positions.description: Positions marked with * (asterisk) are 'darurat dan atau sementara' — temporary/emergency positions
temporary_positions.implication: KITAS for these positions may be shorter term or have additional renewal requirements
